zh: floor(n/k) 只有 O(√n) 种不同取值，而且同一个商对应的分母 k 是一段连续区间；题目要求 x<n，只有 k=1 会产生 n 本身。
整除分块：当前分母 k 的商 q=n/k，在分母 k..n/q 范围内保持不变；把 q 累加一次后直接跳到 n/q+1，就不会重复计入同一个商。
answer=0，k 从 2 开始；当 k≤n 时：q=n/k，answer+=q，k=n/q+1。k 超过 n 后商都是 0，不影响和。n 可达 10^10，全程用 64 位整数。
en: floor(n/k) takes only O(sqrt(n)) distinct values, and the denominators giving the same quotient form a contiguous range; since x < n is required, only k = 1 produces n itself.
Divide into quotient blocks: for the current denominator k, q = n/k stays the same for all denominators k..n/q; add q once and jump straight to n/q + 1 so the same quotient is never counted twice.
answer = 0, start with k = 2; while k <= n: q = n/k, answer += q, k = n/q + 1. Once k exceeds n all quotients are 0 and do not change the sum. n can reach 10^10, so use 64-bit integers throughout.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Divide the denominators into quotient blocks starting from k = 2. The current quotient q = n//k stays the same for denominators k..n//q; add q once and jump to the next block.

## Proof of correctness

The largest denominator giving quotient q is floor(n/q), so jumping over that range avoids repeated quotients exactly without missing any later, smaller quotient. Starting from 2 excludes denominator 1, the only one that produces n; once the denominator exceeds n every quotient is 0 and need not be added. There are only O(sqrt(n)) distinct positive quotients.

## Complexity

Time O(sqrt(n)), auxiliary space O(1).
